top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 achievement is mature and settled: proglucagon processing, the incretin effect and glucose-dependent insulin secretion were established as physiology and confirmed by outcome trials and over a decade of clinical use. Drucker, Holst and Mojsov under a citation naming the hormone's physiology and its active form rewards what was discovered. Mojsov's priority is disputed but is the only name tied to the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide. P001 is a defensible second since Knudsen's half-life work was a real mechanistic insight, and any GLP-1 award beats no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented connection to the proposed laureates, although the profile records eight co-authored works with committee member Rickard Sandberg, who is not a proposed laureate
